title: Jr. Copywriter – Mythology, Social Media & AI
description:
**About IdeateLab:**

IdeateLab is a leading digital creative agency based in the vibrant heart of Mumbai, known for redefining the boundaries of creativity and innovation. We’re on an ambitious journey to become India’s No.1 AI-driven creative agency, revolutionizing how brands think, create, and communicate. Our mission is simple — to fuse human imagination with the power of artificial intelligence, delivering smarter, faster, and more impactful creative solutions.

**Role Overview:**

We’re looking for a next-generation copywriter, someone who thinks strategically, writes fearlessly, and works hand-in-hand with AI to craft ideas that move people and brands alike. This isn’t just a traditional copywriting role, it’s for someone who uses AI as a creative partner, leveraging tools to ideate, experiment, and elevate storytelling to new heights.

You’ll conceptualize big ideas, craft high-impact copy, and use AI tools to enhance creative outputs, from campaigns and decks to digital storytelling and real-time content creation.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop original, AI-enhanced concepts and campaigns across digital, ATL, BTL, and integrated platforms.

* Write compelling, intelligent copy for ads, films, websites, social media, and brand experiences.

* Collaborate with Art, Strategy, and Client Servicing teams to deliver insight-led, tech-powered creative work.

* Experiment with AI tools (for ideation, tone optimization, scripting, trend mining, etc.) to boost creative efficiency and innovation.

* Lead creative brainstorms and confidently present AI-augmented ideas and campaigns to clients.

* Maintain brand voice consistency across all channels.

* Stay on top of emerging creative technologies, AI tools, and content trends.

* Manage multiple briefs and deadlines while pushing the boundaries of creative quality.

**Skills & Experience:**

* 5–7 years of experience in advertising, digital, or content marketing agencies.

* A strong portfolio showcasing sharp conceptual thinking, versatility, and standout writing across formats.

* Proven experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, Synthesia, Jasper, Notion AI, etc.) in creative or strategic workflows.

* Deep understanding of brand storytelling, cultural trends, and digital behavior.

* Strong command of English — with an ear for nuance, a flair for wit, and an instinct for strategy.

* Comfortable experimenting, learning, and iterating in a fast-paced, AI-driven environment.

**Why Join Us:**

This is your opportunity to be at the forefront of the AI-creative revolution. You’ll shape how brands use intelligence and imagination to tell stories, working with ambitious teams and clients who believe in the future of AI-led creativity.

* A culture that celebrates curiosity, experimentation, and bold thinking.

* Opportunities to work on diverse, high-impact brands.

* Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools and training.

* Growth pathways into creative leadership roles.

If you think in ideas, write in magic, and speak the language of AI, we want to hear from you.

**Apply at hr@ideatelab.com**

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About us

ATCO Interiors is a Mumbai-based home interiors and furnishing company. We offer a wide range of interior and furnishing products, including soffit panels, facade cladding and exterior panels, and we work closely with architects, interior designers and homeowners. We are looking for a creative, reliable Social Media Manager to grow our brand and bring in quality leads.

Key responsibilities

* Plan and run our social media presence on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and Pinterest
* Create and follow a monthly content calendar (product showcases, project highlights, before/after posts, tips, festive and offer posts)
* Shoot and edit reels, short videos and photos at our showroom and project sites
* Write engaging captions, hashtags and post copy in English and Hindi
* Manage and update our Google Business Profile, including photos, offers and reviews
* Respond to comments and DMs promptly and pass genuine enquiries to the sales team
* Promote showroom events and launches, including architect and designer meets
* Run basic paid campaigns (Meta Ads) to generate leads
* Build and engage with the architect and interior designer community online
* Track performance (reach, engagement, leads) and share a monthly report with suggestions

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience managing social media for a brand, preferably in interiors, real estate, furniture, décor or retail
* Good command of Canva and a video editing app (CapCut, InShot or similar)
* Comfortable shooting good-quality content on a smartphone
* Strong written English; Hindi and Marathi are a plus
* Basic knowledge of Meta Business Suite and Meta Ads Manager
* Good eye for design, colours and trends in interiors
* Organised, self-driven and able to meet deadlines

Good to have

* Experience with architect or B2B-focused content
* Basic photography or videography skills
* Familiarity with SEO, Google Analytics or WhatsApp Business

What we offer

* Fixed monthly salary of ₹15,000 – ₹20,000
* Creative freedom and an opportunity to build a brand from the ground up
* A premium showroom and a wide range of products to create content around
* Room to grow as the business expands

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

**Eighteen95 Technologies Pvt. Ltd.**, through its entity **Industrial Visits**, operates in the educational tourism and experiential learning space. Industrial Visits was established with the vision of bridging the gap between **classroom education and real-world industry exposure** by creating meaningful learning experiences for students and educational institutions.

Industrial Visits specializes in **Industrial Visits, Architecture Study Tours, International Study Tours, Educational Tours, Industry Visits, Business Tours and experiential learning programs** for colleges, universities and other educational institutions.

The company works with industries, corporate organizations, educational institutions and other partners to create structured programs that combine **academic learning, industry exposure, professional interaction and travel experiences**.

The organization has worked with hundreds of colleges and has developed industry partnerships across different sectors. Its programs are designed to provide students with practical exposure beyond traditional classroom learning.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an **experienced and result-oriented Sales & Marketing Manager** to lead and expand the sales and marketing function for **Industrial Visits**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building relationships with **colleges, universities, educational institutions, corporate partners and other relevant stakeholders**, generating leads and converting them into successful business opportunities.

title: Analyst I, Core & Inno Capabilities
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices.

  

We are seeking a curious, analytical, and motivated **Analyst I – Quantitative Research** to join our Mumbai team within the Insights & Analytics (I&A) function at General Mills India Center. This team leads in-house consumer research to understand and interpret consumer behavior. We are looking for an individual to work closely on the **in-house quantitative research** - someone who loves using data to tell stories and deeply understand stakeholders’ needs and the business requirements to provide strategic insights. The role holder should be able to apply research methodologies effectively, manage global projects end to end, able to multi-task, demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and establish oneself as a trusted advisor to stakeholders.

  

Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Project management and execution**

* The candidate will be accountable for end-to-end Quantitative project management which includes –
  + Gaining expertise in using the tools developed in-house and by external vendors
  + Multitasking and managing multiple research projects end to end i.e. from designing a questionnaire, programming surveys to data analysis and reporting
  + Developing knowledge and skills required to apply advanced statistical techniques like Heat maps, Driver’s analysis, Cluster analysis etc. in order to identify patterns and trends from the data.
  + Should be able to design and execute methodologies that involve Concept test, Product test, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitude, Segmentation etc.
* Should be able to create a story out of the insights using compelling narratives, visuals, and data-driven evidence
* Should be able to proactively learn and apply new tools to find unique solutions to business questions
The candidate will be responsible for establishing best practices, standardized ways of working and building internal benchmarks  

**2. Vendor management**

* The candidate must partner with external research agencies and ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines and as per agreed quality standards
Should be able to lead partnership with vendors independently and establish ways of working to gain cost and time efficiency  

  

**3. Stakeholder management**

* Should proactively connect with internal stakeholders to understand their requirements and suggest appropriate research methods to fulfill those requirements with minimum manager supervision.
* Become a trusted advisor and the go-to person for the internal stakeholders, when they need guidance on answering research questions.
Is able to effectively communicate key findings to the stakeholders and the leadership team in meetings  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2 - 3 years** of relevant market research experience including experience in quantitative research, client management, questionnaire design, data analysis and reporting
* Master’s degree or MBA with specialization in Marketing or Market research
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and team members
* Should have experience in different research methodologies like Concept test, Product test, Brand tracking, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitudes etc.
* Must be able to multitask and effectively manage multiple stakeholders, vendors and projects together
* Should possess strong time management, teamwork, critical thinking, analytical, and influencing skills
Should showcase an openness to learn, and willingness & drive to make meaningful business impact in all projects  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Has independently led multi-country Quantitative research studies
* Has experience working with cross-functional teams
* Candidate with experience working with CPG industry and global markets will be preferred
* Experience working on DIY research platforms like Qualtrics, QuestionPro etc. will be an added advantage

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, building and nurturing long-term relationships with clients in the retail, Grocery Chain Store, CVS, Quick Service Restaurant (QSR), and Food & Beverage (F&B) sectors. 7. Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure customer satisfaction and maximize profitability.

8. Achieve and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets for revenue, new customer acquisition, and market share growth.

9. Coordinate with the customer success team/Pre-sales engineering team to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and post-sales support, fostering long-term customer loyalty.

10. Closely work with marketing to represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and networking functions in India to enhance brand visibility, build industry connections and capture valuable project leads, improve leads conversion to help sales revenue growth

* Bachelors or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred

Often leads others in their development; provides input to policies and practices  

  

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. title: Assistant Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
The Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing initiatives across the Skechers India brand website, e-commerce platforms, paid media channels, and other relevant digital touchpoints.  
The role will focus on driving website traffic, improving customer acquisition and conversion, maximizing return on advertising spend (ROAS), and contributing to online sales and revenue growth. The incumbent will work closely with the CRM, Web Development, Content Marketing, E-commerce, and Sales teams, along with external agencies and marketplace partners, to deliver integrated campaigns aligned with brand priorities and commercial objectives.  
The position requires a strong combination of digital marketing expertise, e-commerce platform knowledge, analytical capabilities, and project management skills to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Designation:** Assistant Manager

**Role:** Digital Marketing

**Department:** Marketing & VM  
**Location:** Mumbai (Andheri East)  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Digital Marketing Campaign Management**

* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, search engines, social media, display advertising, and other relevant digital channels.
* Manage paid search, Performance Max, Product Listing Ads (PLA), and other performance marketing campaigns to drive qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue.
* Develop and continuously optimize ad creatives, copy, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and landing pages to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Monitor campaign performance against defined KPIs, including ROI/ROAS, cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, traffic, and revenue.
* Ensure efficient utilization of advertising budgets and achievement of monthly performance targets.

**B. Website and E-commerce Marketing**

* Manage digital marketing activities for the Skechers India brand website, with a focus on traffic acquisition, conversion optimization, and online revenue growth.
* Collaborate with the Web Development and Content Marketing teams to ensure timely execution of website updates, promotional campaigns, product launches, and seasonal initiatives.
* Monitor website performance, customer journeys, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for improving the overall customer experience.
* Coordinate the implementation of landing pages, promotional content, product campaigns, and other website marketing requirements.
* Support website merchandising and digital initiatives in alignment with brand guidelines and business priorities.

**C. E-commerce Marketplace Marketing**

* Plan and execute digital marketing activities across e-commerce partner platforms, including Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant online marketplaces.
* Manage marketplace advertising campaigns, including sponsored ads, product ads, and keyword-based campaigns, to improve product visibility and sales performance.
* Track advertising expenditure, sales contribution, campaign efficiency, and ROAS to achieve monthly marketplace performance targets.
* Monitor seller account health, product listings, catalog performance, inventory availability, and other relevant operational metrics in coordination with internal teams and marketplace partners.
* Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability, marketplace conversion rates, sales performance, and overall account effectiveness.
* Collaborate with e-commerce and sales teams to align promotional activities, advertising investments, and revenue targets.

**D. Analytics, Reporting and Optimization**

* Measure and report the performance of digital marketing campaigns against established objectives, budgets, and KPIs.
* Analyze data from Google Analytics, advertising platforms, CRM tools, and marketplace dashboards to generate actionable insights.
* Prepare regular performance reports covering traffic, conversions, revenue, advertising spend, ROI/ROAS, and other relevant business metrics.
* Evaluate the end-to-end customer journey across multiple digital channels and customer touchpoints.
* Conduct performance analysis, identify trends, and recommend optimization strategies to improve campaign efficiency and business outcomes.
* Use data-driven insights to support budget allocation, campaign planning, and continuous improvement.

**E. SEO and Website Optimization**

* Support on-page and off-page SEO initiatives to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and keyword opportunity assessments.
* Coordinate technical SEO and website optimization requirements with the Web Development team.
* Monitor organic search performance and recommend improvements to website content, metadata, landing pages, and site structure.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Google Analytics to evaluate performance and identify opportunities.

**F. CRM and Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the CRM team to support customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and repeat-purchase initiatives.
* Collaborate with Content Marketing and Creative teams to develop campaign assets, promotional content, and communication aligned with brand guidelines.
* Coordinate with Sales and E-commerce teams to ensure marketing campaigns support business priorities and revenue goals.
* Manage external agencies, platform representatives, and other partners to ensure timely and effective campaign delivery.
* Coordinate campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, and dependencies across internal and external stakeholders.

**G. Project and Budget Management**

* Manage multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and adherence to approved budgets.
* Track advertising expenditure, campaign milestones, and deliverables to ensure accountability and efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, campaign workflows, and cross-functional coordination.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail across campaign execution, reporting, and platform management.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Marketing, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification or certification in Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, Analytics, or E-commerce will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience**

* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, e-commerce marketing, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including budget management, targeting, bidding, and performance optimization.
* Experience managing advertising campaigns on Amazon and Flipkart or other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Demonstrated experience in analyzing campaign performance, managing advertising budgets, and delivering measurable business results.
* Experience in retail, fashion, footwear, lifestyle, or consumer brands will be preferred.

**Technical Skills and Competencies**

**Digital Marketing and Advertising**

* Hands-on proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, paid search, display advertising, and performance marketing.
* Understanding of marketplace advertising, including Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads.
* Knowledge of campaign optimization, audience targeting, keyword bidding, conversion tracking, and budget management.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals, SEM, and digital customer acquisition strategies.

**Analytics and Reporting**

* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), advertising platform dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, and spreadsheet-based performance tracking.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Understanding of KPIs such as ROAS, ROI, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.

**Technology and Marketing Tools**

* Working knowledge of CRM platforms and marketing automation tools.
* Familiarity with SEMrush, Google Search Console, and WordPress.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS will be an advantage.
* Understanding of website analytics, conversion tracking, landing page optimization, and e-commerce platforms.

**Communication and Project Management**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Effective coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Desired Experience and Additional Advantages**

The following capabilities will be considered advantageous:

* Experience in on-page and off-page SEO for static and dynamic websites.
* Strong keyword research, competitor analysis, and organic traffic optimization skills.
* Experience in managing Google Ads campaigns, keyword bids, spending limits, and account performance metrics.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Ads, including sponsored product campaigns and campaign performance optimization.
* Experience with Flipkart Ads and other marketplace advertising platforms.
* Exposure to marketing automation, customer segmentation, lead nurturing, and CRM-led campaigns.
* Understanding of website content management, basic HTML/CSS, and conversion rate optimization.
* Experience working with external digital marketing agencies and cross-functional teams.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passion for the retail, fashion, footwear, and lifestyle industry.
* Customer-centric mindset with an understanding of digital consumer behavior.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
* Strong analytical thinking and a solution-oriented approach.
* Highly organized, with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within defined timelines.
* Collaborative approach with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Innovative mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, customer engagement, and loyalty.
* Commercial awareness and a results-oriented approach to achieving marketing and business objectives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance in this role will be evaluated against agreed business objectives and campaign targets, including:

* Achievement of monthly digital advertising ROI/ROAS targets.
* Contribution to website and e-commerce revenue growth.
* Efficiency of advertising expenditure and achievement of budget targets.
* Improvement in website traffic, conversion rates, and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Marketplace advertising performance and sales contribution across Amazon, Flipkart, and other partner platforms.
* Improvement in organic search visibility and website performance.
* Timely and effective execution of marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Accuracy and timeliness of campaign reporting and performance analysis.
* Effective coordination with internal teams, external agencies, and marketplace partners.

*Note: Specific targets will be established in line with the annual marketing plan, channel budgets, and business objectives.*

**Expected Contribution to the Business**

The Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing will play a critical role in strengthening Skechers India's digital marketing capabilities and supporting its online business growth. The position will ensure consistent execution of marketing initiatives, improve the efficiency of advertising investments, strengthen e-commerce marketplace performance, and enable data-driven decision-making.

By filling this vacancy, the Digital Marketing team will be better positioned to manage its operational responsibilities, execute strategic initiatives effectively, and achieve its annual marketing and commercial objectives without placing an unsustainable workload on existing team members

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

description:

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

Skills

**Marketing Performanc...**

**Job Description**

**About the Role**

As a **Senior Manager — Performance Marketing** within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek Growth Architects — professionals who view regional business, platform operations and marketing through the lens of data and first-principles thinking.

Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.

**Purpose of the Role**

To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested and scaled.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. First-Principles Growth & Execution**

* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.

* Plan, execute and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.

* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.

**2. New User Acquisition, App Installs & Product Sales**

* Own end-to-end acquisition strategy across Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube, App campaigns), Meta (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns), Apple Search Ads and programmatic channels.

* Drive app install volume and quality — managing CPI, install-to-purchase conversion rates and post-install engagement metrics using Branch and internal measurement for attribution.

* Scale new-to-platform customer acquisition while maintaining or improving CAC targets; continuously optimize channel mix based on cost-per-retained-customer, not just cost-per-install.

* Build and manage audience strategies — lookalike models, custom audiences, interest-based targeting and broad prospecting. With structured testing to identify high-value acquisition segments.

* Identify and eliminate fraud, low-quality installs and attribution gaming across app install channels.

* Drive product-level sales performance through paid channels. Structuring campaigns around hero SKUs, new launches, category pushes and seasonal sale events.

* Own Shopping and catalog campaign architecture,product feed optimization, Merchant Center management, product set segmentation and dynamic product ad performance.

* Plan and execute media strategy for 10–15 major sale events per year (pre-sale, during-sale, post-sale), managing traffic spikes while protecting CPA and ROAS targets.

* Build performance frameworks that connect ad spend to actual product economics — contribution margin, ROAS adjusted for returns and true cost-per-profitable-order.

**3. Budget Management, Performance Analytics & Platform Health**

* Make weekly budget allocation decisions across channels based on performance data. Reallocate aggressively from underperforming channels to high-efficiency opportunities.

* Set and track acquisition KPIs: CAC, CPI, Cost per First Purchase, D30 Repurchase Rate by acquisition channel, ROAS, contribution margin adjusted ROAS and new customer percentage.

* Present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership with clear diagnosis, not just reporting explain why metrics moved and what you're doing about it.

* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.

* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting and activation decisions.

* Maintain strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.

**4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Supply Operations**

* Partner with the creative team to build a structured testing pipeline — brief creative assets, define testing hypotheses and measure creative impact on acquisition efficiency.

* Coordinate with product and analytics teams on conversion tracking, attribution setup and measurement infrastructure — own the accuracy of the data you're optimizing against.

* Collaborate with category and supply chain teams to align campaign intensity with inventory availability avoid promoting products that are out of stock or overpromoting SKUs that create downstream inventory problems.

* Collaborate with the category team on pricing, promotions and assortment decisions that affect campaign performance ensuring marketing investments align with margin targets, not just volume goals.

* Design and execute high velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.

* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What You'll Be Measured On**

**Primary Metrics**

Cost per First-Time Customer: What we pay to acquire a new buyer, tracked by channel

App Install Volume & Quality: Install count, install-to-purchase rate, post-install engagement

New Customer GMV Contribution:Revenue generated specifically by first-time buyers

Channel-Level ROAS: Return on ad spend adjusted for returns and product margins

D30 Repurchase Rate: Share of acquired customers who buy again within 30 days, by channel

**Secondary Metrics**

First-Order AOV by Channel: Average basket size of new customers from each acquisition source

New vs. Returning Customer Mix: Share of orders from first-timers vs. repeat buyers

Creative Testing Velocity: Number of creative hypotheses tested per week and win rate

Campaign Contribution Margin: Profit per order after ad cost, COGS and fulfillment

**What we won't measure you on:** vanity install numbers without quality filters, platform-reported ROAS without backend validation or total order count without customer quality context.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech./B.E. from an IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institute, or an equivalent degree with a strong quantitative and analytical focus.

* MBA from a Tier-1 business school is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience & Competencies**

* 7+ years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech or data/business analytics.

* The Engineer Mindset: Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.

* Hands-on expertise running Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns) at meaningful budgets.

* Proven experience driving app installs at scale while maintaining install-to-purchase conversion and post-install quality metrics.

* Strong understanding of product feed management, Merchant Center and catalog ad optimization for e-commerce.

* Technical Savvy: Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.

* Cross-Functional Fluency: Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain and central product environments.

* Ownership You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

* Track record of managing sale events and promotional campaigns with measurable GMV impact.

**Preference**

* Experience in beauty, personal care, health, or FMCG categories — understanding of repurchase cycles, seasonal patterns and how beauty consumers discover and buy products online.

* Familiarity with incrementality testing — geo-holdouts, channel-off tests, or lift studies to measure true campaign impact.

* Experience with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust) — setting up attribution, measuring post-install events and identifying fraud.

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

* Experience with non-biddable channels — affiliate marketing, influencer performance campaigns, programmatic direct deals.

* Knowledge of CPAS (Collaborative Performance Advertising) or similar marketplace-brand collaborative ad products.

* SQL proficiency for pulling and analysing acquisition cohort data independently.

* Experience building or managing a small performance marketing team (2–5 members).

About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. About Company

Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.

Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.

What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.

With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Marketing Manager – Smart Beverage Vending Machines Business
description:
Marketing Manager – Smart Beverage Vending Machines

**We are looking for a business builder, not just a marketing manager.**

**Company:** Innovative Startup | **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Experience:** 5–10+ years preferred | **Qualification:** MBA in Marketing (Mandatory)  
**Job Type:** Full-time | **Work Location:** Pune, with travel to Mumbai and other markets

About Us

We are an ambitious startup developing innovative, automated beverage vending machines for the Indian market. Our initial focus is on Pune and Mumbai, with plans to expand to other cities.

We aim to establish a strong presence in the emerging instant beverage vending business by deploying smart vending machines at high-footfall locations and developing strategic partnerships with businesses, institutions and property owners.

We are looking for an exceptional **Marketing Manager who can generate business, open doors, build strategic relationships and drive revenue growth from day one.**

This is not a conventional marketing job. We need a commercially driven professional who understands how to identify opportunities, approach decision-makers, negotiate deals and convert relationships into actual business.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development and Revenue Generation

* Take ownership of business development and revenue generation for our beverage vending machine business.
* Identify and secure high-potential locations for vending machine installation in Pune and Mumbai.
* Develop business opportunities with shopping malls, corporate offices, IT parks, gyms, fitness centres, colleges, universities, hospitals, railway stations, airports, hotels and other high-footfall locations, subject to relevant permissions.
* Approach decision-makers, pitch our business proposition, negotiate commercial terms and close agreements.
* Build a strong pipeline of qualified prospects and convert opportunities into signed contracts and operational locations.
* Develop innovative commercial models, including revenue sharing, placement agreements, partnerships and other suitable arrangements.

2. Market Intelligence and Business Strategy

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of India's vending machine industry, particularly automated beverage dispensing and instant beverage vending.
* Research competitors, existing vending operators, market trends, customer preferences and emerging business opportunities.
* Identify promising locations, customer segments and business models for rapid market penetration.
* Understand the commercial potential of different locations, including expected footfall, customer demand, operating costs and revenue opportunities.
* Recommend pricing, placement strategies and partnership models that improve profitability and accelerate expansion.

3. Networking and Strategic Partnerships

* Develop relationships with corporate decision-makers, property owners, facility managers, mall operators, gym chains, institutional administrators and other relevant stakeholders.
* Leverage an established professional network to generate qualified business opportunities.
* Establish partnerships with businesses that can provide access to multiple locations or customer networks.
* Represent the company confidently in business meetings, negotiations, industry events and partnership discussions.
* Build long-term relationships that support repeat business and geographical expansion.

4. Sales and Commercial Negotiations

* Prepare compelling business presentations, commercial proposals and partnership pitches.
* Negotiate placement fees, revenue-sharing arrangements, minimum guarantees and other commercial terms where appropriate.
* Convert leads into signed agreements and ensure timely execution of business commitments.
* Work closely with the founders to develop practical, commercially attractive proposals.
* Track leads, meetings, proposals, conversion rates, signed agreements and revenue potential.

5. Launch and Market Expansion

* Lead business development activities for the initial launch in Pune and Mumbai.
* Build a structured pipeline of prospective vending machine locations and strategic accounts.
* Develop relationships with chains and organisations that could support deployment across multiple locations.
* Coordinate with technical and operational teams to ensure new locations are suitable for installation and service.
* Gather market feedback and recommend improvements to the product offering and commercial model.
* Develop a scalable business development strategy for expansion into additional cities.

6. Startup Ownership and Execution

* Work directly with the founders and take responsibility for measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrate initiative, speed, resourcefulness and the ability to operate independently.
* Identify opportunities beyond conventional marketing channels.
* Bring commercially viable ideas, potential partners and new revenue opportunities to the table.
* Focus on business results rather than simply meetings, presentations or marketing activities.

Mandatory Qualifications

* **MBA in Marketing is mandatory.**
* 5–10+ years of relevant experience in business development, sales, strategic partnerships, channel development or commercial marketing.
* Demonstrated success in generating business, acquiring customers, negotiating commercial agreements and meeting revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of the Indian market and commercial decision-making processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to identify commercially attractive opportunities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Pune, Mumbai and other markets as required.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following sectors will be preferred:

* Vending machines and automated retail.
* Coffee vending, beverage dispensing and instant beverage businesses.
* Food and beverage distribution.
* QSR, cafés, food service and hospitality.
* Retail expansion and commercial property partnerships.
* Fitness chains, gyms and wellness businesses.
* Corporate facility management and institutional sales.
* Franchise development, channel partnerships and location-based businesses.
* Consumer products and technology-enabled retail solutions.

**Direct experience in the vending machine industry or an established network within the automated beverage business will be a significant advantage.**

The Candidate We Are Looking For

We want an exceptionally capable business generator who combines intelligence, confidence, communication skills and commercial instinct.

The ideal candidate will be:

* **A natural networker:** Comfortable meeting senior decision-makers and building meaningful business relationships.
* **Highly articulate and persuasive:** Able to communicate confidently, think on their feet and present a compelling commercial proposition.
* **Commercially smart:** Understands what makes a location, partnership or customer commercially valuable.
* **Proactive and well connected:** Knows how to reach the right people and turn introductions into business opportunities.
* **An excellent negotiator:** Capable of structuring mutually beneficial commercial agreements.
* **Market aware:** Understands the vending business, competitive landscape and potential customer segments.
* **Results oriented:** Focused on signed agreements, successful machine placements, revenue and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial:** Comfortable building a business in an early-stage startup where initiative and execution matter more than hierarchy.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate how their personal efforts, market knowledge and professional network have generated substantial business in previous roles.

Compensation and Incentives

* **Salary is no bar for the right candidate.**
* Compensation will be decided based on experience, demonstrated business generation capabilities and suitability for the role.
* Attractive performance-linked incentives will be offered based on business development achievements and agreed performance parameters.
* Significant opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility as the company expands.

We value measurable business results and are prepared to recognise exceptional performance.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their CV along with a brief description of their business development achievements.

Please include:

* MBA qualification and specialisation.
* Total relevant work experience.
* Details of previous roles in sales, marketing or business development.
* Examples of major clients acquired, commercial partnerships established or new markets developed.
* Experience in vending machines, beverages, automated retail or related industries.
* Examples of revenue targets achieved and business generated.
* Current location and willingness to travel across Pune and Mumbai.
* Notice period and expected compensation.

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment:** Full-time

**Apply at:** mysmartgalaxy22@gmail.com

**Email subject:** Application – Marketing Manager – Beverage Vending Business

The Opportunity

If you have the ability to identify opportunities, connect with the right people, close deals and build a business rather than merely manage a marketing function, we would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

About OCA

OCA – What’s the Occasion is a growing retail, gifting, wholesale, and e-commerce business focused on making every occasion special through thoughtfully curated products and exceptional customer service.

We are looking for a proactive, creative, organised, and customer-focused Digital Marketing & Retail Sales Executive to support our physical store and online business. This is a versatile, hands-on role for someone who enjoys interacting with customers, creating engaging digital content, driving sales, and managing day-to-day retail and online operations.

Role Overview

The selected candidate will be responsible for driving sales through both offline and online channels, managing OCA’s social media presence and online product listings, creating promotional content using Canva, and ensuring smooth store operations.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable switching between serving walk-in customers, handling online enquiries, creating marketing content, processing orders, and maintaining inventory and billing records.

Key Responsibilities

1. Retail, Wholesale Sales & Customer Service

- Attend to walk-in customers and assist them in selecting suitable products and gifts.

- Drive retail and wholesale sales by understanding customer needs and recommending relevant products.

- Build relationships with repeat customers and wholesale buyers.

- Follow up on customer enquiries and potential sales leads to improve conversions.

- Promote products through cross-selling, upselling, and relevant gifting suggestions.

- Maintain excellent customer service and ensure a welcoming shopping experience.

- Work towards agreed sales targets and support promotional activities to increase store footfall.

2. Digital Marketing & Social Media Management

- Manage OCA’s social media presence, including Instagram and other relevant platforms.

- Plan and publish regular posts, stories, reels, product showcases, and promotional content.

- Create attractive marketing creatives, banners, product graphics, and festival-related content using Canva.

- Support campaigns for festivals, gifting occasions, new arrivals, offers, and signature curation boxes.

- Develop engaging captions, product descriptions, and promotional messages.

- Respond to comments, direct messages, and enquiries promptly and professionally.

- Explore practical ways to increase online visibility, customer engagement, enquiries, and sales.

- Monitor basic social media and campaign performance and suggest improvements.

3. Online Sales & E-commerce Management

- Add, update, and maintain product listings on OCA’s online sales channels.

- Ensure product descriptions, photographs, prices, variants, and stock availability are accurate.

- Handle online customer enquiries and recommend suitable products.

- Follow up on online leads and convert enquiries into orders.

- Process online orders and coordinate packing, dispatch, and delivery.

- Keep customers informed about order status and address routine service queries.

- Maintain accurate records of online orders, sales, and customer follow-ups.

4. Store Operations & Visual Merchandising

- Assist with daily store opening, closing, and general operational activities.

- Keep the store clean, organised, and visually appealing.

- Arrange products and displays attractively to encourage customer interest and sales.

- Ensure shelves are replenished and products are properly displayed.

- Follow established procedures for store security, customer service, and operational discipline.

5. Inventory, Billing & Order Management

- Maintain accurate stock records for retail and online sales.

- Monitor stock availability and report low-stock items.

- Assist with physical stock counts and periodic inventory checks.

- Check incoming stock and report discrepancies or damaged products.

- Generate bills, receipts, and invoices using the designated billing system.

- Handle cash, card, UPI, and other authorised payment methods accurately.

- Reconcile daily sales and payment records and report discrepancies.

- Coordinate the packing and dispatch of retail, wholesale, and online orders.

Requirements & Qualifications

- Experience: Preferably 1–3 years of experience in retail sales, digital marketing, online sales, or e-commerce operations.

- Education: High school diploma or equivalent; additional qualifications in marketing or commerce are an advantage.

- Canva: Practical working knowledge of Canva is mandatory.

- Social Media: Familiarity with Instagram, social media content creation, and business account management.

- E-commerce: Basic experience with online product listings, order processing, and inventory management.

- Billing: Familiarity with POS systems, billing software, spreadsheets, or basic sales records is desirable.

- Communication: Good written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of Marathi is an advantage.

- Sales Orientation: Customer-focused, persuasive, and comfortable working towards sales targets.

- Creativity: Ability to create attractive product presentations and promotional content independently.

- Organisation: Able to manage multiple tasks, prioritise work, and maintain accurate records.

- Reliability: Punctual, trustworthy, proactive, and willing to take ownership of daily responsibilities.

What We Offer

- Monthly salary of ₹18,000.

- Performance- and target-based sales incentives.

- Employee discounts on OCA products.

- An opportunity to contribute to the growth of a developing retail and online gifting brand.

- Scope for learning, career growth, and increased responsibilities based on performance.

title: Retail Operations Executive (On-Field)
description:
**Location:** Mumbai | Full-time | On-field

Company Description

Hullo is a clean-label food brand on a mission to make honest, thoughtful nutrition accessible to everyone. Born from a parent's struggle to find convenient yet nutritious snacks for children, Hullo creates delicious products using real, recognisable kitchen ingredients, without artificial preservatives or additives.

We're growing our presence across retail stores in Mumbai and are looking for someone who can ensure our products receive the visibility, attention, and care they deserve.

Role Description

We're looking for an energetic, proactive, and organised **Retail Operations & Merchandising Executive** to manage Hullo's presence across existing retail stores.

This is an on-field role focused on visiting retail outlets where Hullo products are already available, ensuring proper product placement, maintaining strong retailer relationships, coordinating in-store promotional activities, and monitoring product availability and performance.

**This is not a traditional sales role focused on cold calling or acquiring new retailers.** The primary responsibility is to strengthen our existing retail presence, improve in-store execution, and ensure our products are consistently visible, well-stocked, and presented correctly.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Retail Store Visits & Merchandising**

* Visit assigned retail outlets regularly to monitor Hullo's product presence.
* Ensure products are displayed neatly, prominently, and according to brand guidelines.
* Check shelf placement, product visibility, pricing labels, and promotional displays.
* Identify opportunities to improve product positioning and visibility within stores.
* Ensure products are clean, undamaged, and displayed with appropriate branding.

**2. Retailer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with store owners, managers, and retail staff.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with existing retail partners.
* Address retailer concerns regarding product availability, deliveries, displays, and other operational issues.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve retailer queries and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Gather feedback from retailers and store staff about customer preferences and product performance.

**3. Stock Monitoring & Replenishment**

* Monitor product availability and stock levels at retail outlets.
* Identify low-stock, out-of-stock, slow-moving, and near-expiry products.
* Coordinate replenishment requirements with the internal sales and dispatch teams.
* Ensure proper stock rotation and adherence to FEFO (First Expiry, First Out).
* Track product movement and share updates on store-level performance.

**4. In-Store Promotions & Brand Activities**

* Coordinate and execute product sampling, tasting sessions, and other promotional activities at retail outlets.
* Ensure promotional materials, display stands, and point-of-sale branding are placed correctly.
* Work with the marketing team to execute in-store campaigns and product launches.
* Educate store staff about Hullo's products, ingredients, flavours, and key differentiators.
* Gather customer reactions and feedback during sampling activities.

**5. Retail Audits & Reporting**

* Take photographs of product displays and share regular store visit updates.
* Maintain records of store visits, stock availability, product placement, and retailer feedback.
* Monitor competitor product placement, pricing, promotions, and in-store visibility.
* Identify issues affecting product visibility or movement and recommend improvements.
* Prepare daily visit reports and coordinate follow-up actions with the team.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills, particularly when interacting with retail store owners and managers.
* Strong organisational and follow-up skills.
* Basic understanding of retail merchandising, product placement, and store operations.
* Ability to identify and resolve on-ground operational issues.
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, Google Sheets, and basic reporting tools.
* Ability to travel regularly across assigned retail locations in Mumbai.
* Proactive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership.

Experience & Qualifications

* 0–2 years of experience in retail operations, merchandising, field marketing, FMCG, or modern trade is preferred.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in retail operations are welcome to apply.
* Experience working with FMCG, food and beverage, D2C, or consumer brands is an advantage.
* A bachelor's degree or diploma in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.
* Familiarity with Mumbai's retail market and modern trade stores is an added advantage.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who enjoys being on the field, interacting with people, and making things happen.

You should be observant enough to notice when a product is poorly displayed, proactive enough to get it corrected, and organised enough to ensure the issue doesn't repeat.

We're looking for someone who takes pride in how Hullo is represented in every store and understands that great retail execution is just as important as getting a product onto the shelf.

Employment Details

**Location:** Mumbai (On-field, across assigned retail outlets)

**Industry:** Food & Beverage / FMCG

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Role Type:** Retail Operations, Merchandising & Brand Activation

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
Growth & Marketing Manager

**Location:** Mumbai | Full-time | Hybrid flexibility

**Compensation:** ₹8–12 LPA, depending on experience and capabilities

About Quickeee

Quickeee is a fashion quick-commerce startup built around one simple idea: **why wait days for fashion when you can get it in 60 minutes?**

We're rethinking how people discover, shop for, and receive fashion, combining speed, convenience, and experiences like Try & Buy.

We're an early-stage, execution-focused team building something ambitious. And we're looking for someone who wants to build alongside us.

Who we're looking for

We're looking for a curious, analytical, creative, and entrepreneurial thinker who loves figuring out how businesses grow.

You might be someone who:

* Has worked at a marketing agency, handled multiple brands, and wants to take ownership of growing one.
* Has worked in growth, marketing, or the founder's office at a startup and wants more responsibility.
* Has tried building a startup of their own, whether it succeeded or not.
* Is exceptionally capable, early in their career, and has already demonstrated real marketing or entrepreneurial skills.

**We care more about how you think, what you've built, and how quickly you learn than impressive titles or degrees.**

What you'll do

**1. Own growth strategy and experimentation**

* Identify opportunities to acquire, engage, and retain customers.
* Develop creative online and offline growth strategies.
* Understand customer behaviour, competitors, trends, and emerging opportunities.
* Design and run experiments, measure results, and scale what works.

**2. Lead our marketing agencies**

* Work closely with our existing performance marketing and content creation agencies.
* Develop campaign strategies, briefs, and creative directions.
* Review agency performance, challenge assumptions, and identify improvements.
* Ensure marketing efforts contribute to measurable business outcomes.

**3. Make data-driven decisions**

* Monitor acquisition costs, conversions, campaign ROI, retention, and customer behaviour.
* Use analytics to understand what's working and what isn't.
* Translate data into clear actions and recommendations.
* Continuously improve marketing efficiency and resource allocation.

**4. Think beyond digital marketing**

* Explore offline activations, partnerships, community initiatives, referrals, and unconventional acquisition channels.
* Identify creative ways to build awareness and demand within our delivery locations.
* Collaborate with product, technology, operations, and leadership teams to improve customer growth.

What makes you a great fit

* Ideally 2–5 years of relevant experience, preferably in an agency, D2C brand, consumer startup, or high-ownership growth role.
* Exposure to multiple brands, campaigns, or customer acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with numbers.
* Creative problem-solving skills and an instinct for consumer behaviour.
* Understanding of performance marketing, marketing funnels, and campaign economics.
* Ability to turn ideas into execution through internal teams and external partners.
* High curiosity, ownership, adaptability, and a genuine desire to continuously learn.

Bonus points if you

* Have founded or attempted to build a startup.
* Have managed multiple clients at a marketing agency.
* Have worked with consumer apps, fashion, D2C, marketplaces, or quick commerce.
* Have executed growth campaigns with limited budgets.
* Can demonstrate an unconventional growth experiment that actually worked.

Why join us?

* **Real ownership:** Your ideas can directly influence how Quickeee grows.
* **Work closely with founders:** Get exposure to business strategy, product, technology, and operations.
* **Freedom to experiment:** Test creative ideas, challenge assumptions, and learn from results.
* **Resources to execute:** You'll work with existing content and performance marketing agencies rather than having to do everything yourself.
* **Growth opportunity:** Take on increasing responsibility as the company scales.

How to apply

Skip the generic cover letter.

Along with your profile, tell us:

* What's one growth experiment or marketing initiative you've personally worked on that you're proud of?
* If you had ₹1 lakh to grow a fashion delivery startup in Mumbai, what would you try first, and why?
* What's something interesting you've learned recently that changed how you think about marketing or business?

We're open to unconventional backgrounds, former founders, and ambitious professionals whose abilities go beyond their current job titles.

**If you enjoy solving difficult problems, questioning assumptions, and building things from scratch, we'd love to hear from you.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time

title: Store Manager
description:
**Company:** AZA Fashions  
**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Department:** Retail Operations  
**Designation:** Store Manager

About AZA Fashions

AZA Fashions is a leading destination for luxury Indian designer wear, bringing together an exclusive selection of celebrated designers and emerging talent. With a strong presence in the luxury fashion retail space, AZA offers an exceptional shopping experience through its curated collections, personalized service, and commitment to quality.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and customer-centric **Store Manager** to oversee the day-to-day operations of our luxury fashion retail store in Mumbai. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in premium or luxury retail, excellent leadership skills, and a proven track record of driving sales, managing high-value clientele, and delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales & Business Performance**

* Drive store sales, revenue growth, and profitability by achieving monthly and annual targets.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including conversion rate, average transaction value (ATV), units per transaction (UPT), and sales per square foot.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve sales performance and customer conversion.
* Identify business opportunities, monitor sales trends, and provide regular performance reports to management.

**2. Customer Experience & Clienteling**

* Ensure a premium, personalized shopping experience for HNI and UHNI clientele.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value customers through personalized follow-ups and clienteling initiatives.
* Handle customer escalations professionally and ensure timely resolution.
* Drive customer retention, repeat purchases, and brand loyalty.

**3. Team Management & Development**

* Lead, motivate, and manage a team of Fashion Consultants and retail associates.
* Set individual sales targets, monitor performance, and conduct regular feedback sessions.
* Coach the team on product knowledge, styling, selling techniques, and customer engagement.
* Manage staff scheduling, attendance, grooming, and overall discipline.

**4. Store Operations & Visual Merchandising**

* Oversee daily store operations, ensuring adherence to company policies and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain high standards of store presentation, visual merchandising, and product displays in coordination with the VM team.
* Ensure proper inventory management, stock replenishment, transfers, and periodic stock audits.
* Monitor billing, cash handling, documentation, and store closing procedures.
* Ensure the store maintains the brand's luxury positioning and presentation standards.

**5. Inventory & Loss Prevention**

* Monitor stock movement, product availability, and inventory accuracy.
* Minimize stock discrepancies, damages, and losses through effective controls.
* Coordinate with warehouse and merchandising teams for timely replenishment and inventory planning.

**6. Reporting & Compliance**

* Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly sales and operational reports.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, retail processes, and applicable statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with central teams, including HR, Finance, Merchandising, Marketing, and Operations, to ensure smooth store functioning.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Retail Management, Fashion Management, or Business Administration will be an advantage.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in retail, including at least 2–3 years in a Store Manager or equivalent leadership role.
* Experience in luxury or premium retail, designer fashion, ethnic wear, bridal couture, jewellery, or high-end lifestyle brands is preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing retail teams.
* Strong understanding of retail KPIs, inventory management, clienteling, and store operations.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage HNI/UHNI customers and build long-term customer relationships.
* Strong leadership, team development, and decision-making abilities.
* High standards of personal grooming, professionalism, and customer service.

Key Competencies

* Luxury Customer Experience
* Sales & Revenue Management
* Team Leadership & Performance Management
* Clienteling & Relationship Building
* Retail Operations & Inventory Control
* Visual Merchandising
* Business Acumen & Analytical Skills
* Communication & Stakeholder Management

**Work Location:** AZA Fashions, Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Interested candidates** with relevant luxury or premium retail experience and a passion for fashion may apply with their updated resume, current CTC, expected CTC, and notice period.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

title: Product Launch Manager
description:
Role Overview

  

This role is responsible for supporting the successful preparation and coordination of new products, features, and capabilities through effective cross-functional coordination, stakeholder management, and operational planning.

The ideal candidate excels at bringing clarity to complex initiatives, proactively identifying risks and dependencies, supporting stakeholder alignment, and coordinating execution against agreed launch plans.

They are natural communicators, critical thinkers, and problem solvers who can navigate ambiguity and ensure the team is equipped for successful product adoption and operational readiness work effectively within a complex environment and support teams in achieving product adoption and operational readiness.

**Job Responsibilities**

**1. Product Launch Process Execution**

* Coordinate and support the execution of the product launch process across assigned products, features, and capabilities, identifying opportunities for improvement
* Coordinate launch planning activities, working with relevant stakeholders to define and track milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables
* Coordinate cross-functional launch readiness reviews, track agreed actions, and follow up with participating teams
* Support consistent and efficient execution of launch activities in line with agreed objectives, processes, and best practices
* Monitor launch progress, identify potential blockers, and work with relevant stakeholders to address or escalate issues that may impact launch success

**2. Operational Readiness & Excellence**

* Partner with Product Management, Delivery, Support, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, and Operations teams to identify and complete readiness requirements
* Support and coordinate the development and execution of readiness plans, including process updates, training, documentation, tooling, and support models
* Apply and maintain agreed readiness frameworks, standards, and best practices, and contribute suggestions for their improvement
* Maintain launch documentation and final deliverables repositories, supporting accurate audit records and history tracking
* Create and maintain project plans, schedules, status reports, and stakeholder updates for assigned launch initiatives
* Identify risks, dependencies, process gaps, and operational challenges, and support the development and tracking of appropriate mitigation actions
* Support operational discipline by documenting and tracking actions, decisions, and commitments completion
* Use agreed measures to monitor launch effectiveness and readiness outcomes, and support post-launch performance reporting and lessons learned

**3. Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Engagement**

* Build effective relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams to support alignment, transparency, and collaboration
* Act as a key coordination point for teams involved in assigned launch and readiness activities
* Support structured decision-making by providing relevant information, highlighting competing priorities and escalating conflicting requirements where appropriate
* Work effectively across teams without direct authority, fostering collaboration, and maintaining momentum against agreed actions
* Ensure stakeholders remain informed through clear, concise, proactive, and timely communications

**4. Process Optimization**

* Analyze existing launch and readiness activities and identify opportunities for improvement
* Use data, stakeholder feedback, and lessons learned to recommend improvements to operational efficiency and scalability
* Contribute to the development and adoption of repeatable approaches and best practices that improve consistency across product launches
* Use appropriate AI capabilities and tools, where suitable, to support efficient delivery and execution of launch activities
* Identify and escalate significant challenges, risks, and critical pain points through the appropriate governance channels

  
  

Experience and Skills

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations, or a related field, preferably within the software industry.
* Experience supporting product launches and coordinating cross-functional initiatives from planning through execution.
* Understanding of product lifecycle management, go-to-market processes, and Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong analytical, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to identify risks, dependencies, and practical solutions.
* Proficiency with collaboration and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Microsoft Office, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and their application to operational processes is an advantage.

**What We're Looking For**

We welcome candidates who are collaborative, proactive, and highly organized, with the ability to build strong relationships and bring clarity to complex initiatives. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across diverse teams, coordinating multiple priorities, and translating business objectives into structured and actionable launch plans. They will help drive alignment, track progress, and support teams in delivering successful product launches and operational readiness outcomes.
