title: Analyst, Operations & Enablement, Privacy/AI Governance
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**

**Analyst, Operations & Enablement, Privacy/AI Governance**

Our People & Culture and Legal teams make sure we provide a highly ethical working environment where everyone at Priceline can bring their whole selves to work and deliver their very best each day. We want you to thrive – to feel safe, supported, valued, and growing to your highest potential!

**Why is this job a big deal:**

The position will own the operational backbone of the Privacy/AI Governance and Cyber Advisory team at Priceline, including program workflows in JIRA and Confluence, the OneTrust ecosystem, shared reporting platforms such as LogicGate and AuditBoard. This role requires an understanding of our data processing environment and infrastructure, controls and risk profile. An understanding of the company’s innovative utilization of AI technology to serve our customers and our own productivity in an ethical, responsible and trustworthy manner is essential.

The Analyst will be part of a high-performing, dynamic and diverse Legal team at Priceline, a US subsidiary of the biggest online travel company of the world.

**In this role you will:**

**Own Platform Enablement and Operations**

* Be the team Administrator for OneTrust (DSAR, PIA/DPIA, cookie compliance modules) and be the team liaison with associated platforms (BigID, LogicGate, Panryas, Atlassian platforms, Slack).
* Configure, optimize and continuously improve workflows, automation reporting and tooling with existing platforms and with **AI enterprise capabilities, including Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, to ensure effective and audit-ready documentation and evidence trails.** These workflows include DSARS, RoPA maintenance, PIA/DPIAs and other essential governance processes.
* Monitor and triage platform issues, failures, or workflow breakdowns.
* Liaise with OneTrust & other platform support and internal engineering to resolve technical issues.

**Produce and Maintain Process Metrics, Dashboards & Reporting**

* Prepare executive-ready reporting for legal, risk, and leadership.
* Create, improve and maintain Operations documentation and SOPs.

**Ensure Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Maintain close and supportive cross-functional collaboration with Technology, Security, Marketing, People & Culture, Legal Operations and colleagues at sibling brands and the Booking Holdings Corporate Centre.

**You have these preferred** **qualifications:**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in privacy or security operations, data governance, compliance, or GRC programs, preferably within consulting, IT services, or global capability centres (GCCs) supporting privacy, security or compliance programs.
* Solid Experience working with AI enterprise platforms and tooling, e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.
* Hands-on experience working with privacy or AI compliance or GRC platforms (e.g., OneTrust preferred; TrustArc, Security, BigID, ServiceNow, or similar tools) and compliance processes such as DSAR workflows, privacy impact assessments (PIAs/DPIAs), ROPAs and data mapping.
* Understanding of data flows, system integrations, and data lifecycle principles.
* Experience partnering with technical teams (engineering, IT, or security) to troubleshoot issues and implement process or system improvements
* Familiarity with operationalizing the requirements of global regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other data protection laws.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional workstreams across legal, security, product, and business teams
* Relevant certifications such as CIPM, CIPP/E, CIPP/US, AIGC or ISO/privacy-related certifications

**#LI-Hybrid**

**Who We Are**
==============

**WE ARE PRICELINE.**

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

**Flexible work at Priceline**
==============================

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

**Perks & Benefits at Priceline**
=================================

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

**Health & wellness coverage** including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

**Generous time off** including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

**Work/life support** including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

**Financial security programs** such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

**Signature travel perks** including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

**Additional perks & discounts** like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

**A people-first culture** with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*

**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
============================

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

**Applying for this position**

We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all **current employees**, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.

External candidates are required to have an account before applying.

title: Senior Salon Manager
description:
Senior Salon Manager

**Location:** Mumbai  
**Industry:** Premium / Luxury Salon & Beauty  
**Department:** Salon Operations  
**Experience:** 6–10 years in the Salon / Beauty Industry  
**Managerial Experience:** Minimum 3–5 years in a Salon Manager / Senior Salon Manager / Assistant Salon Manager / Salon Operations role

About the Role

JCB Salons is looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior Salon Manager** to lead the operations of our premium salon at **Mumbai**.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in managing a premium or high-footfall salon, leading large teams, driving revenue and sales targets, managing client relationships, and ensuring high standards of service and salon operations.

The candidate will be responsible for the overall performance of the salon, including **business growth, team management, client experience, operational excellence, and revenue generation**.

Key Responsibilities

1. Salon Operations

* Manage the complete day-to-day operations of the salon.
* Ensure smooth functioning of all salon departments and services.
* Monitor appointments, walk-ins, staff availability, service flow, and salon capacity.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs, operational processes, hygiene, grooming, and service standards.
* Ensure the salon is maintained to premium brand standards at all times.
* Coordinate with the Head Office and relevant departments for operational requirements.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures.

2. Sales & Revenue Management

* Take ownership of the salon's monthly and annual revenue targets.
* Drive service sales, retail sales, memberships, packages, and other revenue streams.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.
* Analyse revenue, average bill value, customer frequency, service mix, and team productivity.
* Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
* Develop strategies to improve revenue, client retention, and repeat business.
* Ensure individual team members achieve their respective business targets.

3. Team Management

* Lead and manage the complete salon team, including stylists, beauticians, therapists, reception/front desk, and support staff.
* Plan staff rosters, shifts, leave schedules, and manpower deployment.
* Monitor individual and team performance.
* Conduct regular team briefings and performance reviews.
* Coach and motivate team members to improve productivity and service quality.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Handle attendance, discipline, grooming, behavioural, and performance-related matters.
* Maintain a positive and professional working environment.

4. Client Experience & Relationship Management

* Ensure a premium and personalised customer experience.
* Build strong relationships with regular, premium, and VIP clients.
* Personally handle escalated customer complaints and service concerns.
* Ensure customer complaints are resolved professionally and within the required timelines.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify areas for improvement.
* Drive client retention, repeat visits, memberships, packages, and referrals.
* Ensure consistent service standards across all team members.

5. Performance & Business Analysis

* Review salon performance on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Track revenue, targets, productivity, staff utilisation, client footfall, average bill value, and other key performance indicators.
* Prepare and share regular performance reports with management.
* Identify trends and business opportunities to improve salon performance.
* Work with management on strategies for business growth and profitability.

6. Inventory & Stock Management

* Monitor professional products, retail products, consumables, and other salon inventory.
* Ensure adequate stock availability for daily operations.
* Monitor product usage and minimise wastage.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams for stock requirements and replenishment.
* Ensure proper storage and usage of salon products.

7. Administration & Compliance

* Ensure proper maintenance of salon records and operational documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Coordinate with HR regarding attendance, manpower requirements, employee concerns, and other people-related matters.
* Ensure all team members follow grooming, hygiene, and workplace standards.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the salon.

8. Marketing & Business Development

* Support local marketing and promotional activities to increase salon footfall.
* Identify opportunities for client acquisition and retention.
* Work with the marketing and management teams on salon-specific campaigns and initiatives.
* Build relationships with local customers, corporates, luxury communities, and potential business partners where required.

Experience & Candidate Profile

* **6–10 years of overall experience in the Salon / Beauty Industry is mandatory.**
* Minimum **3–5 years of managerial experience** as a Salon Manager, Senior Salon Manager, Assistant Salon Manager, Salon Operations Manager, or equivalent role.
* Candidates must have prior experience managing a **premium, luxury, or high-footfall salon**.
* Experience managing a sizeable team of stylists, beauticians, therapists, receptionists, and support staff.
* Strong experience in **sales, revenue management, target achievement, client management, and salon operations**.
* Proven ability to drive business growth and improve team productivity.
* Experience handling premium and VIP clientele will be highly preferred.
* Experience with salon management software such as **Zenoti** or similar platforms will be an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent customer service and relationship-management skills.
* Strong commercial understanding with a result-oriented approach.
* Candidate should be well-groomed, confident, presentable, and professional.

Preferred Candidate Background

Preference will be given to candidates currently working or previously working with **reputed premium/luxury salon and beauty brands**.

Candidates from the following backgrounds may be considered:

* Premium / Luxury Salon Chains
* High-end Independent Salons
* Luxury Beauty & Wellness Brands
* Premium Spa & Wellness Businesses with strong salon operations

**Direct salon/beauty industry experience is mandatory.** Candidates with only general retail, hospitality, or non-salon management experience will not be preferred.

Key Competencies

* Salon Operations Management
* Team Leadership & People Management
* Sales & Revenue Management
* Target Achievement
* Client Relationship Management
* Premium Customer Experience
* Staff Productivity & Performance Management
* Business Development
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Inventory Management
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Commercial & Business Acumen

Role Objective

The Senior Salon Manager will be responsible for **end-to-end salon performance**, ensuring operational excellence, strong team productivity, exceptional customer experience, and consistent achievement of business and revenue targets at the **JCB Salons**

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

title: SEO, AEO/GEO & B2B Content Distribution Specialist
description:
**Company:** WDI (Website Developers India Pvt. Ltd.)  
**Location:** Mumbai, India  
**Employment:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1-3 years preferred  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Target Markets:** UK, USA and Global  
**Industry:** IT Services, Software Development, AI and Digital Product Engineering

About WDI

WDI is a digital product engineering and software development company with over two decades of experience building mobile applications, web platforms, custom software and AI-powered solutions.

We are strengthening our organic search visibility and B2B digital presence across international markets, particularly the UK and USA.

We are looking for a hands-on digital marketing specialist who can execute on-page SEO, implement emerging Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) practices, and manage organic B2B content distribution across relevant platforms.

Key Responsibilities

**1. On-Page SEO & Website Optimisation — 20%**

* Execute on-page SEO across the company's new website, including service, solution, industry, case study and landing pages.
* Implement and optimise title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H6 headings, URLs, internal links, image alt text and content structure.
* Work with the approved keyword mapping to optimise each page for its primary and secondary search intent.
* Audit pages for indexing issues, canonical tags, crawlability, sitemap configuration, robots directives and broken links.
* Coordinate with frontend developers to resolve technical SEO issues.
* Review mobile usability, page performance and Core Web Vitals.
* Implement and validate relevant structured data using Schema.org and JSON-LD.
* Perform pre-publication SEO audits and maintain page-wise optimisation checklists.
* Use Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 to identify opportunities and monitor organic performance.

**2. AEO & GEO Optimisation — 40%**

* Implement Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) practices across website content.
* Understand how AI-powered search and answer platforms, including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and other AI assistants, discover, interpret and reference business information.
* Structure content using clear answers, contextual explanations, relevant questions, semantic headings and meaningful entity relationships.
* Improve content extractability and citation readiness for AI-powered search.
* Ensure consistency of WDI's services, expertise, business identity and approved claims across the website and external business profiles.
* Implement appropriate structured data and verify that it accurately represents visible content.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen E-E-A-T through original case studies, technical insights, author expertise, testimonials and verifiable evidence.
* Monitor WDI brand visibility and citations in AI-generated answers.
* Track competitor visibility and recommend improvements.

**3. B2B Content Distribution & Organic Outreach — 30%**

* Own and maintain a monthly organic B2B content distribution calendar targeting founders, CTOs, technology leaders and business decision-makers, primarily in the UK and USA.
* Distribute approved blogs, case studies, white papers, technical articles and thought-leadership content across relevant platforms.
* Manage organic distribution through the WDI LinkedIn company page and designated senior leadership accounts.
* Repurpose long-form content into LinkedIn posts, articles, carousels, short-form insights, discussions and community contributions.
* Publish relevant, helpful responses on Quora and Reddit while following community rules and avoiding promotional spam.
* Coordinate technical-content contributions to developer communities such as DEV Community and DZone.
* Maintain and improve WDI profiles on Clutch, GoodFirms and other relevant B2B directories.
* Identify opportunities for guest articles, editorial contributions, industry publications, expert commentary and relevant partner collaborations.
* Conduct personalised organic outreach to editors, community managers, industry platforms and potential content collaborators.
* Coordinate with technical team members and senior management to collect insights for distribution.
* Manage content-distribution tracking links, publication records and follow-ups.
* Focus on relevant business audiences, earned visibility, qualified referral traffic and brand credibility rather than vanity engagement metrics.

**4. Analytics, Reporting & Coordination — 10%**

* Track keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, organic traffic, engagement and conversion performance.
* Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity and Factors.ai to understand visitor acquisition and behaviour.
* Track referring domains, referral traffic, distribution performance and relevant inbound enquiries.
* Maintain a dashboard showing completed SEO tasks, published content, distribution activity and measurable outcomes.
* Provide weekly progress updates and monthly performance summaries.
* Work closely with frontend developers, content writers, designers, subject-matter experts and management.

Required Skills & Knowledge

**SEO & Technical Skills**

* Strong practical experience in on-page SEO.
* Working understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and website rendering.
* Knowledge of technical SEO, website architecture, crawlability and indexability.
* Experience with Google Search Console, GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
* Familiarity with Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Semrush or comparable SEO platforms.
* Understanding of Schema.org, JSON-LD, canonical tags, XML sitemaps and Core Web Vitals.
* Ability to independently audit a webpage and prepare actionable developer tasks.

**AEO & GEO Skills**

* Working knowledge of generative AI search and answer platforms.
* Understanding of entity-based SEO, semantic search, topical authority and information retrieval.
* Ability to create AI-answer-friendly content structures without keyword stuffing.
* Familiarity with structured data validation, AI search visibility monitoring and citation analysis.
* Understanding of E-E-A-T principles and evidence-backed content.
* Willingness to learn and adapt to changes in search and AI discovery.

**Content Distribution Skills**

* Experience managing organic B2B LinkedIn content.
* Understanding of content repurposing and multi-platform publishing.
* Familiarity with Reddit, Quora, developer communities and B2B directories.
* Basic understanding of editorial outreach, digital PR and ethical link earning.
* Strong written English and the ability to edit technical content for business audiences.
* Experience using AI writing and research tools responsibly, with human fact-checking and editorial review.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, IT or a related discipline.
* 1-3 years of relevant experience in SEO, digital marketing or organic B2B content marketing.
* Prior experience with an IT services, SaaS, software development or technology company.
* Experience targeting UK or US B2B audiences.
* Demonstrable examples of websites optimised, content distributed, organic traffic improved or relevant business enquiries generated.

Key Performance Indicators

Success will be evaluated through:

* **Website SEO execution:** Percentage of completed pages audited, optimised and verified against approved checklists.
* **Technical SEO quality:** Timely identification and resolution of assigned SEO issues.
* **Organic search performance:** Growth in relevant non-branded impressions, clicks and qualified organic visits.
* **AI search visibility:** Measurable improvements in accurate brand mentions, relevant citations and discoverability in selected AI platforms.
* **Content distribution:** Consistent execution of the approved monthly distribution calendar.
* **Earned authority:** Growth in relevant editorial mentions, quality referring domains and business directory presence.
* **Lead contribution:** Qualified UK/US website enquiries and engagement attributable to organic search or distributed content.

What We Expect

We are looking for someone who can execute independently, take ownership of deliverables and work closely with our technical and management teams.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable using AI tools, understand modern search behaviour, be capable of making hands-on website SEO improvements, and demonstrate a proactive approach to distributing content and building B2B digital visibility.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

title: Sr. SEO Specialist
description:
Job Profile: Senior SEO & Organic Growth Specialist

**Experience:** 4–7+ years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Kandivali West, Mumbai  
**Department:** Digital Marketing  
**Role:** SEO Strategy, Technical SEO, Organic Growth & AI Visibility  
**Our Website** : www.2techbrothers.com

About the Role

At 2 Tech Brothers , we believe SEO is much more than ranking a website on Google. It is about making sure our clients' businesses are discoverable, credible, and visible wherever potential customers search for information, products, and services.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on **Senior SEO & Organic Growth Specialist** who can take complete ownership of SEO performance and organic growth across our client portfolio.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of technical SEO, keyword strategy, content optimisation, website architecture, link building, analytics, and emerging AI-powered search platforms. They should be capable of identifying opportunities, developing actionable strategies, implementing improvements, monitoring results, and continuously working towards better performance.

This is an ownership-driven role. We need someone who can independently manage SEO projects, proactively identify problems, communicate with clients and internal teams, and demonstrate measurable improvements in rankings, organic traffic, lead generation, and overall digital visibility.

Key Responsibilities1. SEO Strategy & Organic Growth

* Develop and execute customised SEO strategies based on each client's business objectives, industry, competition, and target audience.
* Take complete ownership of SEO performance across multiple client websites.
* Conduct comprehensive SEO audits and prepare actionable roadmaps with clear priorities and timelines.
* Perform keyword research, search intent analysis, competitor benchmarking, and keyword gap analysis.
* Improve keyword rankings, organic traffic, qualified leads, and conversions.
* Identify new ranking opportunities across products, services, locations, and high-intent search queries.
* Monitor competitors and proactively identify opportunities to improve our clients' online positioning.

2. Technical SEO & Website Health

* Conduct technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, canonicalisation, redirects, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and duplicate content.
* Identify and resolve technical issues affecting search engine visibility.
* Work with developers to implement SEO recommendations across WordPress, Webflow, Next.js, React, and other website platforms.
* Optimise website architecture, internal linking, URL structures, metadata, headings, and structured data.
* Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile usability, page speed, and overall website health.
* Investigate indexing issues, broken links, crawl errors, toxic backlink alerts, and sudden ranking or traffic drops.
* Ensure website changes, migrations, redesigns, and new page launches follow SEO best practices.

3. On-Page SEO & Content Strategy

* Develop keyword-focused content strategies aligned with user intent and business goals.
* Optimise landing pages, service pages, location pages, blogs, and FAQs.
* Build content clusters and internal linking structures to strengthen topical authority.
* Create SEO briefs and collaborate with writers, designers, and developers to improve content quality and performance.
* Ensure content is useful, relevant, original, and aligned with search engine guidelines.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve existing pages rather than relying only on publishing new content.

4. AI Search Visibility & Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)

* Improve client visibility across Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and other relevant AI-powered discovery platforms.
* Develop strategies to help search engines and AI systems understand, recognise, and accurately reference client brands.
* Improve website structure, content clarity, entity signals, schema markup, FAQs, and authoritative brand information.
* Monitor brand mentions, citations, recommendations, and visibility for relevant project, service, product, and location-based queries.
* Analyse how competitors are being referenced in AI-generated answers and identify opportunities to strengthen client visibility.
* Integrate AI search optimisation with conventional SEO rather than treating them as separate, unrelated activities.

5. Link Building & Domain Authority

* Plan and execute sustainable backlink acquisition and digital authority-building strategies.
* Analyse backlink profiles, referring domains, link quality, and competitor link-building activities.
* Identify potentially harmful backlinks and manage disavowal recommendations where appropriate.
* Improve domain authority through relevant, credible, and industry-specific link acquisition.
* Monitor suspicious domains, unauthorised brand-related microsites, and websites that may compete with or divert traffic from client websites.
* Focus on quality, relevance, and measurable outcomes instead of pursuing backlink volume alone.

6. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Tracking

* Monitor and analyse performance through Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC), Google Tag Manager, and relevant SEO tools.
* Prepare monthly SEO reports covering keyword movements, organic traffic, conversions, technical health, backlinks, competitor performance, and growth opportunities.
* Track progress against agreed KPIs and explain the business impact of SEO activities.
* Identify performance declines early and recommend corrective measures.
* Use tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, and similar platforms.
* Maintain clear documentation of completed tasks, pending issues, priorities, and next steps for every client.

7. Client & Project Ownership

* Independently manage SEO activities for multiple clients across different industries.
* Take responsibility for planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate with developers, content writers, designers, and digital marketing teams to ensure timely implementation.
* Communicate SEO progress, challenges, opportunities, and recommendations in simple, professional language.
* Ensure agreed deliverables are completed on time and maintain a proactive approach to client requirements.
* Stay updated with search engine algorithm changes, SEO developments, AI search trends, and industry best practices.

Required Skills & Experience

* 4–7+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably managing multiple client websites.
* Strong expertise in technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword research, content optimisation, and link building.
* Practical experience with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush or Ahrefs, and website crawling tools.
* Good understanding of website development, HTML, CSS, JavaScript rendering, indexing, and structured data.
* Experience working with WordPress and familiarity with modern frameworks such as Next.js and React.
* Knowledge of Core Web Vitals, website performance, mobile SEO, and site migrations.
* Understanding of local SEO, location-based landing pages, and competitor analysis.
* Familiarity with AI search visibility, GEO, entity optimisation, and brand discoverability across AI platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and take accountability for results.

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Improve organic search visibility and rankings for relevant business keywords.
* Increase qualified organic traffic and contribute to measurable lead or conversion growth.
* Maintain strong technical SEO health and address critical issues promptly.
* Identify and act on competitor opportunities before they become missed growth opportunities.
* Strengthen brand visibility across traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms.
* Provide transparent reporting, actionable insights, and a clear SEO growth roadmap for every assigned client.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who goes beyond generating reports and recommending changes. We need a professional who understands why a website is not performing, knows what needs to be done, works with the relevant teams to implement the solution, and measures the results.

The right candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, take ownership of client performance, and continuously look for ways to improve search visibility and business outcomes.

**If you are passionate about SEO, organic growth, technical problem-solving, and the future of AI-powered search, we would like to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

**About Social Refuel**

Social Refuel is an event management and experiential solutions company based in Mumbai, creating engaging experiences and original intellectual properties (IPs).

We are developing a large-scale finance-focused conference, exhibition and experiential platform connecting financial knowledge, investing, entrepreneurship, fintech innovation and the broader financial ecosystem.

**About the Opportunity**

We are looking for an experienced, research-oriented and proactive Finance Research & Conference Programming Associate to support the development of our upcoming finance-focused IP on a project basis.

The role involves industry research, conference benchmarking, programme development, speaker mapping, professional outreach and project coordination in close collaboration with IP leadership.

**Key Responsibilities1. Finance & Industry Research**

* Research the Indian finance, fintech, investment and financial services ecosystem.
* Track developments across banking, digital payments, lending, wealth management, insurance, taxation, mutual funds, stock markets and financial technology.
* Map financial institutions, fintech companies, investment platforms, startups and industry associations.
* Compile industry insights, credible statistics and research findings into structured reports.

**2. Conference Benchmarking & Market Intelligence**

* Research comparable finance, fintech, investment and business conferences in India and internationally.
* Analyse event formats, programme structures, audience profiles, speaker line-ups and participating organisations.
* Identify emerging themes, programme gaps and opportunities to differentiate the IP.
* Prepare benchmarking reports and recommendations for strategic planning.

**3. Conference Programme & Agenda Development**

* Develop conference themes, programme tracks and proposed agendas.
* Research session formats such as keynotes, fireside chats, expert panels, debates and workshops.
* Map sessions to audience needs, relevant experts and desired learning outcomes.
* Refine programme proposals based on feedback from IP leadership.

**4. Speaker Research & Outreach**

* Identify relevant founders, investors, economists, fund managers, financial educators, banking professionals and fintech leaders.
* Prepare detailed speaker profiles and map candidates to programme tracks.
* Draft personalised invitations and manage approved professional outreach.
* Track responses, follow-ups and confirmations, and coordinate introductory meetings.
* Collect speaker biographies, photographs, designations and briefing information.

**5. Partnerships & Ecosystem Mapping**

* Identify potential knowledge partners, financial institutions, fintech companies and industry bodies.
* Prepare organisation profiles and background research for partnership discussions.
* Map relevant professional associations, educational institutions, investor communities and business networks.

**6. Project Coordination & Documentation**

* Maintain research databases, benchmarking reports, speaker trackers and programme documents.
* Track project milestones, deliverables and programme revisions.
* Coordinate information handovers between IP leadership, marketing, partnerships and production teams.
* Verify research sources and flag outdated or unsupported financial claims.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Banking, Financial Markets or a related discipline.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in finance research, industry research, conference programming, business events, financial services or a related field.
* Strong understanding of the finance, fintech, investment or financial services ecosystem.
* Proven research, analytical thinking, information verification and report-writing skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage professionally with senior stakeholders.
* Experience preparing research reports, benchmarking studies, databases or structured programme documents.
* Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple deliverables and deadlines.
* Familiarity with financial markets, investment products, industry events or finance certifications is an advantage.

**What You Will Gain**

* Direct involvement in developing a finance-focused conference and experiential IP.
* Exposure to finance, fintech, investment and financial services leaders.
* Practical experience in conference strategy, programme development and speaker engagement.
* Opportunities to contribute to industry partnerships and strategic research.
* Close collaboration with IP leadership on the development of a new business platform.

**Project Deliverables & Success Metrics**

Success will be measured by research accuracy, quality of benchmarking reports, relevance of programme recommendations, completeness of speaker mapping, progress of approved outreach and timely completion of agreed deliverables.

Project scope, timelines, deliverables and compensation will be mutually agreed upon before commencement.

**How to Apply**

Email your CV to **jobs@socialrefuel.com** with the subject line:

**Finance Research & Conference Programming Associate – Project-Based Application**

Immediate joiners are preferred. Please include your relevant experience, key projects, areas of finance expertise and availability.

**Office Address:** Social Refuel Bungalow, B 31, Fire Brigade Road, beside the SBI ATM, behind Twin House Colony, Parksite Colony, Vikhroli West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400079.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

* Have you worked on developing conference agendas, panel discussions, speaker sessions or programmes for finance, fintech or investment events?

* Have you worked on sponsorship acquisition, brand partnerships or strategic alliances for conferences, business events or industry platforms?

At **Nouryon**, our global team takes positive action every day to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.

* Leverage Artificial Intelligence tools to improve sales productivity, forecasting accuracy, market intelligence gathering, and reporting.
* Prepare business reports, market analyses, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.
* Ensure compliance with Nouryon policies, competition laws, corporate directives, and the Nouryon Code of Conduct.
* Represent Nouryon through engagement with industry associations, regulatory authorities, and professional organizations where required.

Great if you have

* Strong understanding of Polymer Specialties applications, particularly Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls.
* Knowledge of Polyolefins, PVC, Styrenics, Recycling, Pharma, and related industries.
* Experience in Key Account Management, business development, and commercial negotiations.
* Exposure to new product development processes and technical customer support.
* Strong analytical capabilities to interpret market trends and business intelligence.
* Experience working in a matrix and international business environment.
* Ability to leverage CRM systems, forecasting tools, and Artificial Intelligence technologies to drive business outcomes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

We believe you are...

* Customer-focused and commercially driven.
* Results-oriented with a proactive growth mindset.
* Strong in relationship building and stakeholder management.
* Analytical and capable of translating market insights into business opportunities.
* Self-motivated, energetic, and enthusiastic.
* A collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and cross-cultural skills.
* Comfortable working independently while managing multiple priorities.

We believe you bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, or related technical discipline.
* Minimum 5-10 years of experience in the polymer industry with a techno-commercial background.
* Experience within PVC, Polyolefins, Styrenics, Recycling, or similar specialty chemical industries.
* Understanding of Organic Peroxides and Metal Alkyls applications and their end-use markets.
* Experience interacting with customers at mid to senior management levels.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, cross-functional, and international environment.

At Nouryon, we support your personal growth through challenging positions, broad market exposure, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities in a dynamic, international, and diverse working environment.

This is a permanent full-time position based in **Mumbai, India**, supporting the **Polymer Specialties - Organic Peroxides & Metal Alkyls business** across the Indian Subcontinent. **Function:** Marketing  
**Sub-Function:** Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning)  
**Designation:** Manager / Deputy Manager – Marketing  
**Joining Location:** Mumbai – Andheri East  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor (IC)  
**Regional Responsibility:** West Region, with oversight of North Region resources  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager – Marketing & VM  
**Experience:** 7+ years, preferably 8–9 years  
**Qualification:** Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing Strategy**

* Support the development and execution of regional experiential marketing and retail activation strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives.
* Translate national marketing campaigns and brand priorities into relevant regional and local market activation plans.
* Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement through innovative retail experiences, events, activations, and localized campaigns.
* Develop activation concepts that are relevant to the target consumer and aligned with the brand's positioning.
* Ensure all regional activations maintain consistency with brand guidelines and communication standards.
* Recommend new and innovative activation formats based on market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity.

**2. Campaign Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across retail, experiential, events, print, digital and other relevant channels.
* Own regional campaign calendars and ensure timely execution of planned marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors for campaign planning and execution.
* Prepare detailed campaign briefs, execution plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Monitor campaign implementation from conceptualization through execution and closure.
* Ensure all campaign assets, branding elements and communication materials are delivered within agreed timelines.
* Conduct post-campaign reviews and identify opportunities for improvement.

**3. Retail Store Activation**

* Partner with Retail Operations and Sales teams to identify opportunities for increasing customer footfall, engagement, and conversion through localized activations.
* Develop and execute store-level promotional activities, consumer engagement programs, and local marketing initiatives.
* Support new store launches, store anniversaries, key retail moments and other business-critical initiatives.
* Develop activation plans for high-priority stores, malls, markets, and catchment areas.
* Ensure activation activities are aligned with store objectives and deliver measurable business impact.
* Gather feedback from stores and regional teams to continuously improve activation effectiveness.

**4. Experiential Events, Partnerships & Sponsorships**

* Plan and execute experiential events, consumer engagement activities, brand experiences, and promotional events.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities for relevant partnerships, sponsorships, collaborations, and local events.
* Coordinate with athletes, influencers, event partners, malls, retailers, and other external stakeholders where applicable.
* Manage event agencies and other external partners to ensure quality and timely execution.
* Ensure event experiences are consistent with brand identity and provide meaningful consumer engagement.
* Track event performance and prepare post-event reports with key learnings and recommendations.

**5. Market & Consumer Research**

* Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, retail trends, and competitor marketing activities.
* Conduct market scans to identify relevant opportunities for regional activations.
* Analyze competitor campaigns, events, promotions, and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Provide insights to the marketing team on regional consumer preferences and market opportunities.
* Use market intelligence to recommend localized marketing initiatives and improve campaign effectiveness.

**6. Brand Management & Compliance**

* Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines across all regional activations and consumer touchpoints.
* Work closely with creative and VM teams to ensure all campaign communication and physical branding elements meet brand standards.
* Review marketing collateral, activation concepts, and event branding before execution.
* Ensure agencies, vendors and other partners understand and adhere to brand requirements.
* Identify and address any gaps in brand execution across the region.

**7. Creative & Content Coordination**

* Work with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop campaign and activation communication.
* Prepare clear creative briefs covering campaign objectives, target audience, messaging, deliverables, and timelines.
* Coordinate development of promotional assets, event communication, retail communication, and digital content as required.
* Review creative outputs and provide relevant feedback to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
* Coordinate with digital and social media teams to amplify relevant retail activation and experiential initiatives.

**8. Social Media & Digital Integration**

* Coordinate with digital/social media teams to ensure relevant experiential and retail campaigns receive appropriate digital amplification.
* Support the development of content around events, activations, launches, and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Monitor campaign-related digital engagement and consumer response.
* Identify opportunities to integrate offline retail experiences with digital marketing initiatives.
* Ensure regional activation content is aligned with the overall digital communication strategy.

**9. Collaboration with Sales & Retail Operations**

* Work closely with Sales, Retail Operations and VM teams to understand regional business priorities and translate them into marketing activation plans.
* Support sales teams with relevant marketing initiatives that contribute to store traffic, consumer engagement, and sales.
* Participate in regional business reviews and provide marketing recommendations.
* Ensure marketing initiatives are planned based on store requirements, business priorities, and market potential.
* Establish strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns.

**10. West Region Ownership**

* Take end-to-end ownership of retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives for the West region.
* Develop regional activation plans based on business priorities, market potential, and consumer insights.
* Manage the regional marketing calendar and ensure timely execution.
* Coordinate with stores, regional business teams, agencies, and vendors.
* Monitor execution quality and ensure timely resolution of regional activation-related issues.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of regional initiatives and share actionable insights with the senior marketing team.

**11. North Region Resource Oversight & Mentoring**

* Provide functional guidance and mentorship to marketing resources supporting the North region.
* Review and monitor the North team's marketing activation plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Ensure consistency in campaign execution, brand standards and reporting across West and North regions.
* Support North resources in campaign planning, agency coordination, event execution, and problem-solving.
* Review key deliverables and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and effectiveness.
* Act as a point of coordination between North regional resources and the central Marketing & VM team wherever required.
* Track progress against agreed deliverables and escalate critical gaps or delays to the reporting manager.
* Build capability within the North resources through regular guidance, knowledge sharing and best-practice sharing.

**12. Agency & Vendor Management**

* Identify, coordinate, and manage experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production partners, and other vendors.
* Brief agencies clearly on campaign objectives, scope, timelines, and expected deliverables.
* Evaluate agency proposals and execution plans based on quality, relevance, feasibility, and cost.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and deliverables.
* Ensure proper documentation and closure of marketing activities with external partners.
* Build strong agency/vendor relationships while maintaining commercial discipline.

**13. Budget Management & Cost Optimization**

* Support planning and management of regional marketing and activation budgets.
* Track campaign and activation spend against approved budgets.
* Ensure effective utilization of marketing spends and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Review vendor quotations and proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for marketing spends approvals and campaign closures.
* Ensure activities are executed within approved financial parameters.

**14. Campaign Performance & Reporting**

* Establish relevant KPIs for retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Track campaign performance, consumer engagement, footfall, participation, and other relevant metrics.
* Prepare regular reports on campaign progress, spends, execution status and business impact.
* Conduct post-campaign analysis and identify key learnings.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve future campaigns.
* Maintain a structured repository of campaign plans, reports, photographs, learnings, and performance data.

**15. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Marketing, VM, Retail Operations, Sales, Digital, Creative, Finance and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure effective communication of campaign requirements and timelines across functions.
* Coordinate multiple stakeholders simultaneously to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Proactively identify execution challenges and drive timely resolution.
* Act as a strong bridge between the central marketing team and regional business teams.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

The role will be evaluated on:

* Timely execution of regional retail activation and experiential marketing campaigns.
* Quality and consistency of campaign execution across the West region.
* Effectiveness of retail activations in driving consumer engagement and store objectives.
* Successful execution of store launches, events, and key marketing initiatives.
* Adherence to approved marketing budgets and cost optimization.
* Agency and vendor performance management.
* Campaign ROI and performance measurement.
* Quality and timeliness of marketing reports and post-campaign analysis.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across Marketing, Sales, and Retail Operations.
* Effective oversight, mentoring, and delivery tracking of North region resources.
* Consistency of brand standards across regional activations.
* Identification and implementation of innovative experiential marketing opportunities.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have:

* **7+ years of relevant experience**, preferably 8–9 years, in Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing, Brand Activation, Events or a related field.
* Prior experience in **retail, consumer-facing, lifestyle, footwear, fashion, FMCG, consumer durables or other retail-oriented industries** will be preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience in **experiential marketing, retail activations, events, and campaign execution**.
* Experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of retail marketing and consumer engagement.
* Experience working with creative, experiential and event agencies.
* Ability to independently manage regional marketing initiatives from planning to execution and evaluation.
* Experience in mentoring or guiding junior/peer resources will be an advantage.
* Strong commercial understanding and ability to manage marketing budgets effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment.

**Educational Qualification**

* **Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing** from a recognized institute.
* Additional certification in Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Experiential Marketing or Event Management would be an advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Experiential Marketing and Retail Activation**.
* Campaign planning and execution.
* Event management and consumer engagement.
* Agency and vendor management.
* Market and competitor analysis.
* Budget tracking and cost management.
* Campaign performance measurement and reporting.
* Strong understanding of retail marketing dynamics.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word**.
* Strong presentation and report-making skills.
* Familiarity with digital marketing and social media platforms.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and derive actionable insights.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* **Strong communication and interpersonal skills**
* Strategic and creative thinking
* Ownership and accountability
* Strong execution orientation
* Stakeholder management
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Problem-solving ability
* Commercial acumen
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Agility and adaptability
* Ability to influence without direct authority
* Mentoring and coaching mindset
* Strong follow-through and commitment to timelines

**Role Summary**

This is an **Individual Contributor role with regional ownership**, responsible for driving **Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing for the West region**, while also providing **functional oversight, mentoring, and deliverable monitoring for North region marketing resources**.

The role requires a candidate who can combine **strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution**, effectively collaborate with Sales, Retail Operations, VM, Creative and Digital teams, and deliver impactful consumer experiences that strengthen the brand and contribute to business growth.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Head Technology & Innovation
description:
**Job Description**:

**Huntsman Corporation** is now looking for a dynamic individual as a **Head Technology & Innovation.** The main objective is to develop new products and new technology platforms for the Indian market. This is done by managing technical resources (people, equipment, facilities, FC and intellectual property) within the Technology & Innovation team.

The EAIME business requires a dedicated team to develop, validate and support commercialization of new products and applications to drive differentiated growth through a world class innovation pipeline into existing as well as new market spaces to enhance the business portfolio. These resources are managed centrally for maximizing impact through a disciplined approach to project work, risk management as well as leverage and build new technical capabilities within the regional business. Close collaboration with the rest of the organisation is key for success.

The Platform Manager must be able to effectively deal with the Marketing and Commercial team decision makers as well as work with a number of external partners. Furthermore, the incumbent must work across a wide range of internal personnel in a manner which builds trust, buy-in and understanding. The incumbent must be able to positively influence all the relationships mentioned above and be able to help define, articulate and communicate the value of the project portfolio.

The level of interactions include higher level strategic, tactical and short- and long-term projects (3+ years).

Major challenge for this position includes the ability to manage a complex portfolio of Product Innovation projects with a potential of high impact to the business, some results of the decisions taken will only be visible 3 years later or more.

Project portfolio management includes allocating appropriate resource levels based on potential value creation for the business and providing strong technical expertise to deliver the project efficiently.

The incumbent will have to be open minded to manage a complex portfolio of high impact projects and develop the skills and competences in the team to deliver those projects.

Another challenge is to implement a strong project management culture in his/her organisation to ensure most efficient resource utilisation and decision taking.

The expectation is that an interdependent, collaborative and team-oriented approach will be undertaken.

This position will be based in Mumbai, India.

**As a** **Head Technology & Innovation**, **you will:**

Ensure that all activities are conducted to the highest standards of Safety, Health and Corporate Compliance and that the team behavior demonstrates a commitment to safety culture.

To efficiently manage and drive a portfolio of product development projects for maximum impact and to ensure full alignment to the regional business strategy. Projects can be related to exploring applications and markets.

To manage and develop the team to improve the delivery of product innovation projects and maximizes value creation for the business.

To ensure a good connection with platform managers in Tienen and other regions to allow efficient localization of established technologies, taking into account local raw materials and market needs.

To support the innovation director in defining and delivering the EAIME vision and strategic trusts.

To manage a seamless integration/collaboration with the other groups of the EAIME organisation as well as Global Research to ensure most efficient project delivery.

Foster an open and collaborative culture to ensure most efficient use of resources, knowhow and expertise available in the organisation.

To be an active member of the IMT (India Management Team)

**What skills and experiences are we looking for?**

The ideal candidate should have a Master in a technical discipline preferably in a chemical related field and have extensive managerial and applications experience.

He/she should have 15-20 yrs experience in the company or 10yrs in the Polyurethane industry

The candidate should have an in-depth knowledge of how polyurethane works and the processing/applications benefits that can be achieved in existing as well as in potential new application and markets.

The candidate must have proven managerial skills and ability to take far reaching decisions and influence situations at senior level.

The candidate must have the ability to manage a diverse project portfolio as well as be able to set priorities in a complex environment.

Ideally the candidate, in addition to the education above should have 15+ years technical development experience with a track record of project delivery, people management and organisational development.

In lieu of the education noted above the candidate could qualify if (s)he possessed 15+ years experience in advanced polyurethane product and application environment.

The incumbent, due to his/her experience, must be able to focus on strategic issues without compromising potential tactical choices.

**What can we offer?**

Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6,000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service – and the list goes on.

Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us.

Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local.

Please refer to **https://www.huntsman.com/privacy/online-privacy-notice** for Company’s Data Privacy and Protection information.

All unsolicited resumes presented by recruitment agencies are treated as pro bono information or service.

Huntsman is aware of a scam involving fraudulent job offers. Huntsman does not make job offers until after a candidate has submitted a job application and has participated in a face-to-face interview. Please be advised that emails from Huntsman always end in “@huntsman.com” and that any job offer that requires payment or requires you to deposit a check is likely a scam. If you have questions about any open positions at Huntsman, please visit our Careers website at

**http://www.huntsman.com/corporate/a/Careers****.**

title: Content Operations, Senior Manager Asia and MENA
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

**About Crunchyroll**
---------------------

Crunchyroll connects anime fans around the world with the stories, characters, creators, and communities they love. Regional Localization & Operations makes Crunchyroll’s content, products, communications, and fan experiences locally relevant, accessible, operationally ready, and consistently executed across markets.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Content Operations - Asia + MENA will lead the operational readiness, delivery, and ongoing management of Crunchyroll’s content across Asia and MENA, based in Mumbai. This role will ensure that titles, episodes, metadata, artwork, subtitles, dubs, ratings, rights information, partner assets, and related content components are complete, accurate, compliant, and available on time across relevant platforms and channels.

You will work across Content, Localization & Dubbing, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Creative Services, Communications, Legal, Customer Experience, Data, Finance, and external vendors and distribution partners. The role will connect content planning with execution, ensuring that regional launches are delivered smoothly and that operational issues are identified, escalated, and resolved quickly.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring strong content operations expertise, project management discipline, attention to detail, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate across multiple markets, time zones, platforms, and launch priorities.

**Role Overview - Lead Regional Content Operations**
----------------------------------------------------

* Develop and manage content operations processes for Asia and MENA across content intake, planning, preparation, delivery, launch, and post-launch support.
* Establish clear workflows, operating standards, ownership models, timelines, dependencies, and escalation paths for regional content execution.
* Coordinate the operational lifecycle of titles and episodes across direct-to-consumer, distribution, partner, and à la carte channel experiences.
* Ensure content packages are complete, accurate, and delivered according to market, platform, partner, and launch requirements.
* Maintain visibility into content readiness, delivery status, risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and open issues across the region.

### **Drive Launch and Market Readiness**

* Lead regional content readiness for new title launches, seasonal programming, simulcasts, catalog releases, campaigns, partner activations, and market expansions.
* Build and maintain launch checklists, readiness trackers, milestone plans, and operational dashboards.
* Coordinate with Content, Localization & Dubbing, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Communications, Customer Experience, and Legal to ensure launch requirements are met.
* Confirm that localized content dubs, and partner deliverables are ready for launch.
* Identify launch risks early and drive mitigation plans, escalation, and resolution.
* Support post-launch reviews to identify operational gaps, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

### **Manage local Content Assets**

* Oversee the readiness, accuracy, and delivery of content assets, including video files, audio tracks, and dubs
* Establish quality-control checks for content packages and coordinate correction of missing, inaccurate, or technically non-compliant assets.
* Partner with Localization & Dubbing teams to track language coverage, dubbing delivery, subtitle readiness, and quality-control status.
* Ensure content information is consistent across internal systems, consumer experiences, partner platforms, and distribution channels.
* Maintain effective asset tracking, version control, documentation, and auditability across the content lifecycle.

### **Coordinate Partners and Vendors**

* Manage operational relationships with localization vendors, dubbing studios, post-production providers, content aggregators, distribution partners, platforms, and other external service providers.
* Establish clear briefs, delivery specifications, service levels, schedules, quality expectations, and issue-resolution processes.
* Monitor vendor and partner performance across timeliness, completeness, quality, responsiveness, capacity, and cost.
* Coordinate onboarding, operational reviews, performance improvement plans, and continuous process enhancement for relevant partners.
* Ensure partner and vendor deliverables are aligned with Crunchyroll’s regional launch and content standards.

### **Support Regional and Global Collaboration**

* Serve as a key operational contact between Asia and MENA regional teams, global Content Operations, Localization, Product, Engineering, and other enterprise functions.
* Translate regional market requirements and operational needs into clear inputs for global planning and platform processes.
* Coordinate handoffs, dependencies, decisions, and actions across teams operating in different markets and time zones.
* Provide clear reporting on readiness, performance, operational risks, incidents, and actions required from regional or global stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships across a matrixed organization and influence outcomes without formal authority.

### **Improve Operational Quality and Scale**

* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, templates, checklists, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and scale content operations across Asia and MENA.
* Analyze recurring defects, delays, incidents, and operational bottlenecks to identify root causes and corrective actions.
* Establish and track operational metrics such as readiness, on-time delivery, asset completeness, defect rates, issue aging, vendor performance, and launch quality.
* Share best practices and market learnings across regional and global teams.
* Support business continuity, incident response, and operational resilience for content delivery and availability.

**Experience and qualifications**
---------------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in content operations, media operations, streaming operations, localization operations, post-production, distribution operations, or a related field.
* Experience managing content delivery and operational readiness across multiple markets, platforms, channels, or distribution partners.
* Strong understanding of content supply chains, including video and dubs, technical delivery requirements.
* Experience coordinating complex launches with multiple dependencies, stakeholders, vendors, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to build and improve operational processes, workflows, checklists, dashboards, and quality-control frameworks.
* Experience managing external vendors, content providers, localization partners, post-production teams, or distribution partners.
* Strong project management, organization, prioritization, and issue-resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Content, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Localization, Legal, Customer Experience, Data, and global teams.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard for content accuracy, completeness, quality, and timeliness.
* Ability to analyze operational data, identify root causes, and translate findings into practical improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise executive and operational updates.
* Comfort working across time zones and in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.
* Willingness to travel regionally and internationally as required.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of relevant Asia or MENA languages is a significant plus.
* Knowledge and passion for anime, entertainment, streaming, and fan communities is a significant plus.

**Why you will love working at Crunchyroll**
--------------------------------------------

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

* Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.
* Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.
* Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance
* Health Saving Account HSA program
* Health care and dependent care FSA
* 401(k) plan, with employer match
* Employer paid commuter benefit
* Support program for new parents
* Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

* Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.
* Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.

title: RBB-IMPERIA RELATIONSHIP MANAGER
description:
**Job Title**

description:
**Campaigns Manager - Advisory Marketing**

**Lloyd’s Register**

**Location: Mumbai, India**

  

**What we’re looking for**

We’re looking for an experienced, commercially minded B2B marketer who can turn strategic priorities and complex services into clear, customer-focused go-to-market campaigns. Comfortable working across teams and managing multiple workstreams, you will combine solid planning and delivery skills with the ability to question constructively, keep stakeholders aligned and maintain momentum from campaign development through to performance reporting.

  

**What we offer you**

The opportunity to work for an organization that has a clear sense of purpose, is values-based and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programmes.

A full-time permanent role

  

**The role**

* Define the campaign scope (could include campaigns such as existing service promotions or new service launches etc).
* Create a campaign plan with clear, measurable KPIs.
* Execute a competitor analysis.
* Execute customer needs analysis and identify and define the IPCs for the campaign (need, segment, job role etc)
* Write service value propositions using the Advisory messing matrix to create a compelling offering that answers the customer needs.
* Co-ordinate the creation of case studies for the services to promote client engagement, proof points and demonstrate client value.
* Enhance or develop the web presence for the service with links to other relevant services where needed.
* Write content for, and co-ordinate the design of print & digital campaign assets (brochures/leaflets, digital ads/banners, emails video etc) as required by campaign plan.
* Work with the Strategic Content team to link campaign to existing campaigns when needed (e.g. FFT/GMT/DMI etc).
* Work with the External Content team to develop Thought Leadership pieces (Horizons, trade interviews etc) for the Advisory Services if required.
* Work with our agencies to create Digital Advertising proposals as part of the campaign as needed.
* Work with our internal delivery team and agencies to develop proposals and deliver Email, Demandbase, Social Media, SEO and PPC channel activity as part of the campaign as needed.
* Identify LR owned event opportunities e.g. workshops, webinars etc as part of the campaign as needed.
* Work with External Comms team to identify 3rd Party events, conferences and speaker opportunities as part of the campaign as needed.
* Identify a comprehensive target customer list for the campaign (existing clients & prospects).
* Create the Sales enablement assets: playbooks, sales slides etc (Segment focus highlighting the services) as part of the campaign as needed.
* Create and execute an internal communication plan for the campaign to include sales engagement training and internal communication channels.
* Map the lead management process and reporting for the campaign (Full funnel & ROMI).
  

**What you bring**

* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering integrated B2B go-to-market campaigns, for professional, technical or advisory services.
* Solid understanding of campaign planning, customer segmentation, value propositions, content development, channel activation and sales enablement.
* Commercial awareness, with the ability to connect marketing activity to customer needs, pipeline and revenue objectives.
* Experience setting meaningful KPIs and using performance data, full-funnel reporting and ROMI insights to optimise campaigns.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex subject matter into clear, compelling and audience-focused messaging.
* Advanced project management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, coordinate agencies and internal teams, manage budgets and deliver to agreed timescales.
* Comfortable collaborating with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts, and sales teams across a matrixed, international organization.
* Curiosity and the ability to learn complex markets and services quickly.
  

**Nice to have**

* Experience in the maritime sector.
  

**You are someone who**

* Is keen to take accountability and ownership for delivering customer needs
* Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards meeting goals
* Is effective at solving problems, trouble-shooting and making timely decisions
* Is motivated and willing to take initiative
* Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language
* Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment
* Responds positively to learning opportunities and is comfortable stepping out of own comfort zone
